question: OLK-6.6 生产 Java 反代节点反复触发 memcg OOM kill，dmesg 显示通过 filemap_fault → mem_cgroup_charge → try_charge_memcg 路径走到 OOM。需要判断是内核 bug 还是配置问题，并给出处理建议。
notes: Product-facing smoke case — open-ended user framing. The diagnostic flow is INTENTIONALLY NOT prescribed; the agent should decide whether this is a kernel bug or a configuration/workload issue and respond appropriately (likely Form C 'no commit-level fix, tune memory.max / workload / overcommit'). expected_kg_paths is the minimum set a thoughtful investigation would touch — Phase 0 (similar crashes), Phase 1 symbol lookup (try_charge_memcg / mem_cgroup_charge to understand the mechanism), Phase 2 LKML/bug search for prior production reports, and get_function_source to read the actual memcg-charge logic. Backport-verification tools (get_regression_fixes / check_backport_status / lookup_subsystem_owner) are NOT in expected paths because for a 'by-design' OOM the agent shouldn't need them. For the QA coverage case that forces ALL paths, see eval/data/cases_coverage.json.
